doc: The E6 vocabulary of the evidence pass (holon.diagram.evidence.Lexicon: names, tokenize, stopwords), written for the blind rerun from code alone. The target code fixes no stopword list and no length cutoff, so none is given: a token is any identifier of the target's languages ([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, split at underscores and case changes, lower-cased) of length at least 1, and the names read are those of the two edge kinds the pass reads, CODEC and TRANS.
